project.title: Genome of a novel lysogenic bacteriophage infecting Achromobacter denitrificans
project.description: This project aims to isolate and characterize a novel lysogenic bacteriophage from Achromobacter denitrificans. We performed whole-genome sequencing of this phage to identify key regulatory genes involved in its life cycle and host interaction.
project.center_name: The First Affiliated Hospital of Xi'an Jiaotong University

samples: Novel lysogenic phage from hospital wastewater infecting Achromobacter denitrificans
runs: Achromobacter phage sp. whole genome sequencing
